idea: Use the original publicly available DOS Colonel deployment routine as an opponent opening prior. Its four fixed arrays and their reflections supply correlated rank assignments. Retain full legal-army support through a20% uniform background.

sources.location: DS:190E, tables4..7; canonical front-first rows4..1, columns1..10 plus horizontal reflections

public_contract: No opponent setup, private deployment seed or referee position accepted. Visible move-seed commands are ignored.
Own setup and ranks are legitimate inputs. Enemy origins are tracked solely through public moves and combat; long Scout moves disclose Scout.
Every historically disclosed enemy original-token rank remains a constraint after capture; moved undisclosed origins must be mobile.
Current public board, enemy captured-rank counts and native memory origin/masks must match tracked history. Unsupported narrower masks are rejected.

posterior_derivation.K: number of historically disclosed enemy origins, including captured pieces
posterior_derivation.k_r: disclosed original-origin count of rank r
posterior_derivation.M: historically moved enemy origins which remain undisclosed
posterior_derivation.template_likelihood: 1 iff every known original rank matches and every moved unknown origin is mobile; else0
posterior_derivation.unnormalized_components: 0.1 * template_likelihood for each of8 templates; 0.2 * Lbackground for the uniform component
posterior_derivation.numeric: Compute likelihood and mixture normalization in log space. All inconsistent templates imply background posterior1.

sampling: Choose a posterior component independently per world. Template draws map each surviving original token to its fixed rank. Uniform-background draws assign the exact remaining immobile multiset uniformly among unmoved unknown slots, then shuffle the exact remaining mobile multiset over the remaining slots. Return weight1 for every world. No approach/retreat likelihood factors.

marginals.notation: U unmoved unknown slots; H remaining hidden mobile count; I remaining hidden Bomb+Flag count
marginals.mixture: Posterior-weighted exact template point masses plus these uniform conditional marginals. Rows sum1 and rank-column sums equal remaining hidden inventory.
marginals.limitation: Marginal interface discards template mobile-rank correlations if used by native consumers; full world sampler preserves them.

comparison: Freeze same native observer,8 worlds,4 plies, correction aggregation and unweighted averaging in template policy and uniform-count control. Evaluate original Colonel generator distribution as primary opponent deployment; separately preserve broad honest/general-opponent stress evaluation.
limits: The procedural20% original generator is screened and nonuniform; our uniform20% component is an explicit robust approximation, not the exact DOS distribution.
The equal prior over templates/reflections is the nominal algorithmic mixture, not a reconstructed private RNG state.
Ignores opponent action likelihood: movement contributes only logical mobile status, not pursuit/retreat behavior.
Policy may be overconfident in surviving templates after revealing their signature. General stress armies will commonly reject every template and reduce to uniform.
Full support does not prevent weak decisions from only8 sampled worlds; no strength claim before fresh frozen evaluation.
validation: Runtime eight canonical template constants exactly match pinned resident extraction.
544 exhaustive small-inventory public-evidence likelihood cases match enumeration to1.12e−16.

11 unit/integration tests pass, including real historical public events, captured Bomb retention, both-army hidden-nibble invariance, exact inventory/masks, marginals, reset, opponent-setup rejection and seed independence.
